subject: Deku Shield
text: The Deku Shield is located on the lower shelf on the right side of the shop and can be purchased for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
You'll find the Deku Shield located on 
the lower shelf on the right side, select it and purchase it if you have 40 
Rupees.

subject: evil plants
text: Defeating the evil plant enemies will most likely yield a Deku Stick.

evidence.quote:
You will most likely acquire a Deku Stick after defeating this 
enemy.

subject: plants
text: The plant enemies inside the Deku Tree drop Deku Nuts when defeated.

evidence.quote:
These enemies will drop Deku Nuts, another new item which you can use to stun 
your enemies.

subject: large chest
text: Opening the large chest at the top of the path yields the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
At the top of the path you will come across a 
large chest.  Open this chest to acquire the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: The defeated Deku Scrub drops a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Grab the Recovery Heart that the Deku Scrub drops and proceed 
through the door that just opened, not the one you came through.

subject: large treasure chest
text: A large treasure chest contains the Fairy Slingshot, which comes with 30 Deku Seeds.

evidence.quote:
The item inside 
turns out to be the FAIRY SLINGSHOT.  The Fairy Slingshot fires Deku Seeds, 
you are given 30 of them automatically to start with and you can find many 
more just by slashing grass and stuff.

subject: treasure chest
text: A treasure chest in a small hidden room reached by climbing the vine contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Before going back to the door note the vine beside this 
chest that you can climb up, it leads to a small hidden room with a treasure 
chest containing RECOVERY HEART.

subject: large treasure chest
text: Inside the large treasure chest across the raised platforms is the Compass for the dungeon.

evidence.quote:
There is a large treasure chest here and inside it you will find the 
COMPASS for the dungeon.

subject: small chest
text: Opening the small chest on the southern ledge awards a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
This time jump from the first platform, to the second platform and then jump 
south to the other ledge.  Open the small chest here to get a RECOVERY HEART 
from it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Defeating the Gold Skulltula on the wall yields the Gold Skulltula 001 token.

evidence.quote:
When the 
enemy has been defeated it will drop an item.  This is GOLD SKULLTULA [001] 
token that proves you killed it.

subject: spider web
text: The spider web in the center of the main room breaks when Link falls onto its middle from a great height.

evidence.quote: Now what you have to do is jump down all the way to the very bottom, remember that spider web in the middle of the room when you came in? Well it's time to break that web, and you break it by falling from such a huge distance down on top of it right in the middle.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Shooting the Gold Skulltula on the vine with two slingshot shots allows Link to collect Gold Skulltula 002.

evidence.quote:
Fire two shots at it to 
kill the monster and then climb up the vine to grab the GOLD SKULLTULA [002].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Shooting the Gold Skulltula on the water gate twice lets Link jump and grab Gold Skulltula 003 in mid air.

evidence.quote:
Take out your 
handy dandy Fairy Slingshot and fire two shots at the enemy to kill it.  Now 
jump from the ledge with the big button toward the water gate and grab the 
GOLD SKULLTULA [003] in mid air.

subject: chest
text: The chest next to the torch yields a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest beside the torch to get a RECOVERY HEART and then whip out one 
of your many Deku Sticks.

subject: Deku Scrub Brothers
text: The Deku Scrub reveals that the brothers must be punished in the order 2, 3, 1.

evidence.quote:
The scrub tells you that you cannot defeat the brothers unless you punish them in the 
right order.  The correct order is 2, 3, 1.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: The Deku Scrub drops a Recovery Heart when defeated.

evidence.quote:
The scrub will drop a Recovery Heart for you 
to pick up but you still can't get out of this room.

subject: eyeball switch
text: Firing the Fairy Slingshot at the eyeball above the door removes the bars and unlocks the door.

evidence.quote:
Here's the trick, equip 
your Fairy Slingshot and aim up at the eyeball above the door.  Fire away at 
the eyeball and the bars will disappear, the door will be unlocked.

subject: underwater button
text: Diving and pressing the underwater button on the south wall lowers the water level so the moving platform passes under the rolling spike log.

evidence.quote:
Jump into the water 
and dive under, take a look along the south wall to find an underwater button 
and when you swim up to it, the button is automatically pressed.  Now with the 
button pressed the water level in this room drops and the moving platform is 
lower than the rolling spike log.

subject: torches
text: Lighting all the torches in the room with a Deku Stick unlocks both doors.

evidence.quote:
Your 
goal is to equip a Deku Stick and light it on fire, then use it to light all 
of the torches in this room.  This will unlock both doors, head north now.
